description: Single source of truth for Morph's conversion matrix. Consumed by the macOS (Swift) app and, later, the Windows (Tauri) app. Keep platform-specific availability notes here so both apps agree on capabilities.

maxDimension.note: Longest edge in px; nil keeps original size

notes.macos: Backed by Image I/O. Writable output types are queried at runtime via CGImageDestinationCopyTypeIdentifiers(); webp output requires macOS 14+.
notes.windows: Planned via the `image` crate; heic/webp may need extra system libraries.

notes.macos: CSV/TSV/JSON via Foundation. XLSX read/write implemented with NO external deps: a minimal ZIP (Compression for inflate, hand-rolled stored writer + CRC32) plus XMLParser for reading and inline-string XML for writing. First worksheet only; dates read as raw serial numbers for now.
